greeting_1.text: Good evening, and welcome to the table. I'm Astrid, take any seat you like.

greeting_2.text: Welcome in. Pull up a chair, the cards are fresh and the table is yours.

greeting_3.text: A new face at the table. Welcome, I'm Astrid, and I'll be dealing for you tonight.

placebets_1.text: Bets are open. Place your chips whenever you're ready.

placebets_2.text: New round, fresh cards. The betting circle is all yours.

placebets_3.text: The table is open. Take your time, and place your bets.

goodluck_1.text: No more bets. Here come the cards.

goodluck_2.text: Bets are closed. Good luck, everyone.

goodluck_3.text: That's all the bets. Let's see what the shoe has for us.

sidebet_1.text: Your side bet comes in. That one pays straight away.

sidebet_2.text: Side bet's a winner. Nice way to start the hand.

sidebet_3.text: And the side bet lands. Paid before we've even begun.

insurance_1.text: Ace showing. Would anyone like insurance?

insurance_2.text: I have an ace. Insurance is open, and it pays two to one.

insurance_3.text: Ace up, so insurance is on offer. Entirely your call.

double_1.text: Doubling down. One card, and one card only.

double_2.text: Double it is. Here's your one card.

double_3.text: Doubled. One card to settle it.

bust_1.text: Over twenty-one, I'm afraid. That hand is done.

bust_3.text: Too many, I'm sorry. That one goes to the house.

blackjack_1.text: Blackjack! Beautifully done. That pays three to two.

blackjack_2.text: Blackjack, straight off the deal. Paid three to two.

blackjack_3.text: Now that's how you open a hand. Blackjack, three to two.

dealerblackjack_1.text: Dealer has blackjack. I'm sorry, everyone.

dealerblackjack_2.text: Blackjack for the house this time. It happens to the best of us.

dealerblackjack_3.text: I'm afraid it's blackjack for me. That round goes to the house.

dealerbust_1.text: Dealer busts! Everyone still in the hand gets paid.

dealerbust_2.text: Too many for me. The house busts. Congratulations, table.

dealerbust_3.text: And that's over twenty-one for the dealer. Winners all round.

win_1.text: Well played. That hand is yours.

win_2.text: You beat me on that one. Congratulations.

win_3.text: A winning hand. Paid in full.

push_1.text: Same total. It's a push, your stake stays with you.

push_2.text: We're level. A push, nobody wins and nobody loses.

lose_1.text: Dealer wins. That one goes to the house.

lose_2.text: Not this time, I'm afraid. The house holds.

lose_3.text: Close, but the house has it this round.

peek_1.text: One moment while I check for blackjack.

peek_3.text: Checking for blackjack. Nothing up my sleeve.

farewell_1.text: Thank you for playing. It was a pleasure dealing for you.

farewell_2.text: All done for tonight? Thank you, it was lovely having you at the table.

farewell_3.text: Good night, and thank you for the company at my table.

chatter1_1.text: Quiet night at the table. Those are my favourite.

chatter1_2.text: Eight decks, shuffled fresh every round. Every hand starts from nothing.

chatter1_3.text: I've dealt a lot of hands at this table. No two ever play out the same.

chatter2_1.text: Take your time. The cards aren't going anywhere.

chatter2_2.text: No rush at all. Think it over.

chatter2_3.text: Whenever you're ready. The decision is yours.
